label: KYC Refresh Prioritization
description: Analyzes upcoming KYC periodic review queue and prioritizes based on risk rating, days overdue, and regulatory requirements. Produces a prioritized work plan.

Customer A — High Risk — Last KYC: Jan 2023 — Due: Jan 2024 — OVERDUE 13 months

...

guidedInputs.label: Team Capacity
guidedInputs.description: Available analyst capacity for the review period.

guidedInputs.label: Primary Jurisdiction
